title: Amazon sold products named by a ChatGPT error

beats.say: This was the name of a product for sale on Amazon.
Not a joke. In January 2024, people found it all over Amazon.

beats.big:
Sellers let
AI write
the titles.
beats.say: Some sellers let ChatGPT write their product titles, and never read them.

beats.sub: its refusal message became the title
beats.say: But the AI refused. And its refusal got posted as the product name.
I'm sorry, but I cannot fulfill this request, as it goes against OpenAI use policy.

beats.sub: all named by an error message
beats.say: On lawn chairs. On religious books. Dozens of listings.
Nobody checked. Not the seller, and not the store.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
